account_population.authority: all syntactically valid unique local /etc/passwd rows with an absolute home path
account_population.binary_safety: NUL or CR in /etc/passwd => ERROR before Bash line parsing.
account_population.home_state: Absent home is outside mode population; existing home must be a real directory; symlink/non-directory/stat ambiguity => ERROR; physical homes deduplicated.
account_population.nss_scope: Local /etc/passwd is v2 authority; network/NSS-only accounts require separate authority before target expansion.
account_population.selector: No UID_MIN or login-shell exclusion. Existing service/system-account home directories are included because source says users without interactive-only qualification.

donor_disposition.adapt: Direct /home donor scan is replaced by all local passwd rows with absolute homes, including root and service/system accounts.
donor_disposition.reject: Interactive-only UID_MIN/shell filtering is rejected after retrospective counterexample; ownership/existence requirements remain out of scope.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs exercised the selected account heuristic and home modes. Evidence supports implementation assumptions; observed modes do not redefine the normative value 0700 and belong to the accepted supported runtime matrix.

non_requirements.existence: SRC-0015 does not require creation of a home directory; an absent selected-account home path is outside the mode population.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is evidence only and is not added to SRC-0015.
non_requirements.sensitive_files: Sensitive file modes belong to SRC-0014 and are not rechecked here.

permissions_control.comparison: For each existing selected user home directory, permission/special bits must equal 0700; this is the exact chmod 700 relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more existing selected home directories have a mode other than 0700.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated and violations=0.
